Section B
Answer one question.

text: Problems for Dairy Farmers in the United States
Milk is used to make a range of products, including butter, cheese and ice cream, as well as
serving as a drink. This was of no help to US dairy farmers in 2009 when they faced a falling
price for their milk. Fig. 1 shows the extent of the price change in recent years. While consumers
purchase milk by volume (litres), farmers are paid by weight (kilograms).
